from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The identifier or title of the document as written (e.g. '判决文书 1')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_category: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal category of the document (e.g. '民事', '刑事', '行政') if stated in the title or header")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
